instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["yaw"] - c["object_long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:
        best_candidate = c
        break

grasp(best_candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
target_spot = None
for spot in spots["spots"]:
    if abs(spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:
        target_spot = spot
        break

carry_to(target_spot["x"], target_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
